tests.name: desktop 1440x900, signed in: /dev/agents/worker, /dev/cicd/runs, /dev/oasis/state, /dev/settings/flags, /dev/vtid/search — ?spotlight=1 renders the section tabs (SubNavigation) directly above [data-archetype="workspace"] (full width, no rail, no horizontal scroll) and ?spotlight=0 renders today's tree without [data-archetype]; DevLayout's admin view-role request is a POST the staging guard aborts; if the Command Hub is switched off on the staging build the spec skips with that reason

Dev screen flag off = legacy tree (section tabs + padded gradient wrapper, no [data-archetype]); flag on = section tabs directly above ScreenFrame "workspace" (full width, no rail, same header, utility row, tabs and panes); every routed Dev page reads useSpotlightEnabled() once, composes ScreenFrame "workspace" behind it and never moves SubNavigation inside it
tests.reason: Covers the per-page source contract for all 42 routed Command Hub pages in jsdom; the staging spec samples five of them in a real browser.
